channel.title: CVE Daily — AI Curated
channel.description: Today's vulnerability landscape is dominated by critical remote code execution, command injection, and authentication bypass flaws spanning Web Security, IoT, Cloud, and Desktop OS categories. High-impact issues affect widely deployed products including Microsoft Office and Windows components, consumer networking hardware from TP-Link and ASUS, developer tools like Visual Studio Code and JetBrains IDEs, and major cloud orchestration platforms. These vulnerabilities primarily exploit memory corruption, privilege escalation pathways, and misconfigured access controls, allowing unauthenticated or low-privileged attackers to compromise system integrity, exfiltrate data, and pivot across internal networks. Immediate remediation is essential to prevent active exploitation and maintain operational security across modern technology infrastructures.
